Products

codnappCore

Develop and manage your microservices, screens and OPC connections on a single core platform.

CodnappCore is a flexible application platform where microservices and user interfaces are developed and managed, and where OPC connections to industrial systems are established.

Without being limited by the ready-made structures of no-code and low-code platforms, you can build processes and applications tailored to your needs.

You can also speed up code production with AI-assisted development tools, making development faster and more efficient. Let AI write your code, and stay in control.

Screenshots use representative data.

codnappConnect

Securely and without interruption, it connects the devices and systems on your shop floor over OPC UA and integrates them with the central platform.

codnappMobile

Your production, with you anytime, anywhere.

Monitor your entire production floor in real time from your mobile devices. Your custom-built app is published on the iOS and Android stores under the name and brand you choose.

Technologies we use

Why Codnapp?

Our name comes from “Code and Application.” “Code” stands for our technical expertise; “Application” stands for our ability to turn that expertise into real business processes and applications. In addition to MES solutions, we provide custom software development services tailored to each business’s needs.

A Team That Knows the Shop Floor

Our two founders bring more than 25 years of combined industry and project experience. We understand the real needs of the production floor and look at processes through the eyes of both the people running operations and the managers making decisions.

Solutions Built for Your Business

Every business has different processes and needs. We don’t force you to adapt to the limits of off-the-shelf software. We first understand your processes and requirements, then shape the software around your business.

You Work Directly with the Founders

From start to finish, you communicate directly with the founding partners who do the work and have the authority to make decisions. This shortens the chain of communication, speeds up decisions and keeps your project moving efficiently.
